clause: Bind variable to property (literal vs binding, re-resolve) [STU-DS-024a]

scope.summary: Implement binding a StudioVariable to a property: binding replaces a raw literal with a live reference, and changing the variable's per-mode value or the active mode re-resolves every bound property. A property MUST hold either a literal or a variable binding, never an ambiguous mix on the same field. The binding UI is an operator surface enforced in parallel by the model command surface.
acceptance_criteria: variable binds to property as live ref; re-resolves on value/mode change; literal-XOR-binding; author_id + manual entry
expected_tests: argus: bind-variable control reachable via author_id on eligible property fields
test: binding replaces literal with live ref; value/mode change re-resolves; field is literal-XOR-binding (no ambiguous mix)

target_entries: Studio / Design Systems / Binding variables to properties

risk_if_missed: Variables cannot drive properties; tokens are inert.

risks: Scaffold-only claim without runtime proof (Spec-Realism Gate).
Domain MT forking a canonical primitive instead of referencing 14.23.
SQLite creep on a studio_* write path.
minimum_controls: At least one proof command exercises executable runtime or a Handshake-managed resource boundary.
Reference canonical primitives (14.23); no shadow primitives.
